newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel diffs steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel diffs steady.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gaaoline and diesel fuel differentials were steady on Thursday, with prices left to track rebounding NYMEX futures prices, traders said.

But spot prices in the Group Three and Chicago markets were expected to generally drift lower through the final weeks of the year on ample stocks and deliveries scheduled late in the month, traders said.
"We're just swimming in it," one trader said of relatively high unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel inventories in the Williams pipeline system.
High sulphur diesel differentials were unchanged in early discussion at 6.50 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago and 8.50 cents under in Group Three.
Prompt low sulphur diesel was bid 6.50 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago and 4.50 cents under in Group Three, where later deliveries were 5.25/5.50 cents under the print.

Unleaded gasoline for prompt deliveries was talked 3.0 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago and 4.25/4.50 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three, with later deliveries 0.50 cent a gallon weaker in both markets.
